Its thin unibody aluminum construction is complemented by Ceramic Shield glass, which is highly resistant to scratches. On the 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR display, you will enjoy a sharp image with a brightness of 3,000 nits, and thanks to ProMotion technology with 120Hz adaptive refresh rate, you can look forward to exceptionally smooth operation. Everything is powered by the A19 Pro chip, which can easily handle demanding games or Apple Intelligence functions. Thanks to all-day battery life and fast charging, iPhone will not disappoint you even with heavy use.

• 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR display with 3,000 nits of brightness
  • Professional 48MP Fusion camera
  • Customizable action button
  • Apple Intelligence for intelligent assistance and productivity
  • All-day battery life and fast charging

At the heart of the phone is the super-powerful A19 Pro chip with evaporative cooling, which, combined with a 6-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, easily handles even the most demanding tasks, whether it's playing AAA games smoothly or using smart features. Plus, with a battery that lasts all day (up to 37 hours of video playback), you don't have to worry about going out without a charger. And when you do run out of power, it only takes 20 minutes to charge to 50%.
